card.name: Byzantine and Serbian ruler names
card.fires_on: Names and linking words in passages about medieval Byzantine and Serbian rulers, such as 'of' after a ruler's name or the end of names like Alexios, Andronikos and Constantine.

modes.label: 'of' after a ruler's name
modes.description: The word 'of' linking a royal name to a place or title.
modes.example: Manuel’s widow, Maria<< of>> Antioch, and Alexios Kom

modes.label: End of ruler names
modes.description: Final pieces of Byzantine names split into several parts.
modes.example: Andronikos was crowned co–emperor in September 1183 and briefly ruled alongside his nephew Alex<<ios>>.

card.plain: It lights up in history text about medieval emperors and kings, on their names and the 'of' after them.
